priority.new_hypothesis: For selected MLB/NHL game milestones, inspect documented related_event_tickers and fetch exact linked event/series metadata; admit only returned series plus literal period predicate. No guessed ticker strings.

priority.group: US unresolved segments and championship awards
priority.method: Complete exact-game market pagination and documented coarse FUTURE filtering; inspect actual typed metadata, period boundary, signed line, award/season/entrant IDs. No sibling key substitution.

targets: six documented league championship outright keys
priority.method: One selected future event per sport; capture both selected books in each complete response. Two bounded polls retain independent updates.
No paid guessed-key requests. Check one documented sports catalog response and selected event market inventory if available within approved allowance. Unchanged official schema findings stay open.

targets: MLB native/provider game IDs, game number, original/rescheduled occurrence, home/away
championship exact sport season, award meaning, selected entrant and field revision
priority.method: Retain explicit source IDs and exact official sporting crosswalk, not ticker/title inference. Missing associations remain exclusions.

limit_justification: Reuse existing finite native HTTP and resource ceilings; prioritize first missing-cell opportunity before any second alias/page. Metadata-only unresolved offerings use zero book connections.

Aggregate 45 documented game/period market keys plus six league outright keys per poll = 51 maximum credits; two polls = 102. Six free event listings + 12 selected event odds + 12 outright pulls + one quota/catalog request = at most 31 HTTP attempts. Actual dispatch accounting must use existing quota reservation and stop before limit; no purchases.
180 seconds covers two independent bounded polls and targeted native changes; ordinary manual Stop, cleanup and exact reopening reuse verified lifecycle. No prolonged cadence or execution benchmark.
Every target remains on the ledger if it is unavailable in this finite window, unreached by allowance, empty or seasonal. One run is not promised to complete all coverage.
required_before_execution: Fresh explicit authorization bound to final candidate, request, window, destination and one unused attempt; all prior authorizations remain exhausted

Translate metadata locator operations into the existing bounded collector and validate exact request schema/accounting offline; the current legacy source-session schema cannot dispatch outright keys. This reviewable request is deliberately not an executable approval package.

At Start resolve current IDs only within approved public discovery; no secrets in chat. No account-document/fill/position/probability prerequisite. No automated trading, outreach, purchases, owner walkthrough or commercial validation
stop_rules: Missing required identity or malformed/incomplete response is evidence only, never absence or a price input
Keep each source failure isolated; do not retry envelope breach or exhausted locator hypothesis
Stop at time/request/credit/byte/memory limits or ordinary manual Stop; uncertain dispatch consumes the new attempt
